scope_note: Agent review on 2026-10-18 UTC inspected fresh main, recent changes, repository instructions, task claims, schemas, diagnostic standard, profiles, tests, validators and CI. Enriched one mite profile and existing primary citation with three claim mappings distinguishing plasmid-standard sensitivity from organism counts, technical replicates from independently sampled plants, and the partial ITS1 accession from whole-genome or image-based causal identification. Full primary publisher HTML resolved at https://academic.oup.com/ee/article/53/1/34/7236580 via its publisher CDN. Methods, Results and discussion were checked; the PDF redirect failed and no access restriction was bypassed. Source title, authors, publisher, DOI and online publication date retained; access date refreshed. Assay-to-image and universal-cutoff limitations are annotation safeguards, not measured field diagnostic accuracy. Added one plant-linked confirmation safeguard and one content-specific test. All profile fields except sources and confirmation, including existing visual symptom context, media, licenses, confidence cap and training permissions, were compared with baseline and preserved. Only mite-hemp-russet changed across the full export. Counts remain 63 profiles, 205 sources, 92 media references, 36 originals, 68 crops and zero training-eligible media. No new source, media, binary or license. Historical URLs were not all independently revalidated. An unrelated modified HLVd reference binary in the original checkout was preserved without copying or publishing it; using-git-worktrees isolated this batch in a sibling workspace without changing repository ignore rules. Offline dependency installation lacked a cached package, so existing installed dependencies were copied from the original checkout; clean baseline tests passed all 291 application tests and data-release validation before edits. A pre-validation profile diff caught a confirmation line matching the neighboring spider-mite array; systematic debugging traced the ambiguous patch context, the line was moved to the intended profile, and the other profile was verified identical to baseline. No test or validator was weakened. All 68 final local commands passed, including 62 validators, 292 application tests, 103 Python tests, type check, build, frozen-artifact verification and diff check; five supplemental evaluator/artifact self-tests passed. JSON/JSONL syntax, source identity, duplicate, label, claim-link and candidate-leakage gates passed. Serial artifact freezes matched actual input provenance; 191-row text artifact pins synchronized without model training. PHP unavailable locally; all exact-head hosted workflows including PHP lint remain required before integration. Verification-before-completion gated publication. Operational claim excluded from publication and released after merge. Prior blocked Botrytis draft untouched and excluded. No production deployment. Remaining gaps include specimen-linked serial Cannabis microscope and canopy image/video, field-abundance calibration, broader specificity validation, independent clinical performance and panel-level training review. Symptom-only, unlinked-organism and DNA-to-abundance-inferred samples retain human-review restrictions. Agent review is not human, expert or laboratory specimen confirmation.
